title: The best kind of weird #theapptmusical #offbroadway #theatre #theappo...
transcript: so today I got to go see The Appointment, which is the abortion musical that is currently playing Off Broadway at the WP Theater until February 4th. and I know the idea of an abortion musical sounds really weird, but, like, trust me, it works. structurally, it kind of reminded me of ain't No Mo, where it's almost vignette, like, but there's kind of this overarching story. in this case, it is the Appointment. and like ain't No Mo, it ranges tonally from being, like, super over the top to very serious. but the shift in tone in this piece is so multi layered and brilliant that the more I think about it, the more I love it. the Appointment truly represents what I personally love to see in theater. a show that keeps you engaged and entertained while you're watching. it also keeps you thinking once you've left the theater, and this show has definitely kept me thinking. it is also, obviously a very timely subject matter, which, in my book, always gives a show bonus points. and the show definitely keeps you entertained in the moment. parts of it are just so weird and bizarre. were parts of the show where it felt like somebody was doing a parody of experimental theater. think like the High School Theater show sketches from SNL. like those sketches. those moments in this show worked because it was very intentional and aware of what it was doing. also thought this show balance the weirdness with the sincerity very well, but it does get very weird. so if the idea of a singing and dancing fetus does not sound like a good time to you, then maybe skip this one. but if you are open to bizarre, I would definitely check it out. I had a fantastic time. there are moments of audience participation in this, but if that completely turns you off, do know that they do ask consent, so if you don't wanna answer anything or respond you do not have to. but all the participation works very well and I always find that entertaining when a show does it. overall super happy I got to see the show. this is a show I'm going to be thinking about for a while, and if if you can handle the weird, I definitely recommend going seeing it.
classificationReason: Creator attended and shares detailed opinion about 'The Appointment' abortion musical, but this show is not in the provided list
